description: Expert planner: for a big, new or vague product it does the R&D (web facts, prior art, a captured reference) and writes a buildable plan (README with a build recipe, PHASES with Done-when checks, contract, shared CONTEXT.txt) that is checked by plan_lint, for the person and for the developers. For small jobs it gives a short plan and triages findings. NOT for a one-file edit or a plain question.
